name: MOBILE CHROME FULLSCREEN NOVA POSHTA PICKER FIX
changes: Opens the full-screen city and warehouse picker directly from tap/click instead of relying on focus of a readonly field
Supports mobile Chrome, installed Chrome PWA and narrow touch devices up to 900px
Prevents document click handling from immediately closing the full-screen picker
Keeps the search input interactive while the original checkout field remains readonly
Adds dialog semantics and Escape handling
Bumps checkout asset URLs and PWA cache to RC28
